Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding nearly 0.7% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising just over 0.1%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Vishay Intertechnology ( VSH ) was up nearly 8% after the chipmaker reported adjusted Q4 net income of $0.58 per share, improving on a $0.37 per share non-GAAP profit during the year-ago period and beating the Capital IQ consensus expecting $0.52 per share.
In other sector news:
(+) Allot Ltd ( ALLT ) climbed 10% after the networking equipment company reported an adjusted Q4 net loss of $0.01 per share during the three months ended Dec. 31, trimming its $0.04 per share loss during the year-ago period and also beating the three-analyst consensus expecting a $0.03 per share net loss.
(-) Glu Mobile ( GLUU ) fell nearly 12% after mobile game-maker reported a Q4 net loss of $0.01 per share, paring its $0.29 per share net loss during the same quarter last year but still missing analyst projections looking for a $0.07 per share profit.
